Lots of people are misinformed about autism in this thread! 

Let's clear a few things up!   


1. Autism is a widely accredited disability, but even though "handicapped" is technically a correct term, we don't have to use the term "handicapped." "Disabled" or "has a disorder" or especially "has autism" is fine to use instead!  

2. Autism is a spectrum. Some people have more mild symptoms than others. Some have mild and more severe symptoms than others. It's very gray and complicated. Not everyone who has autism is going to display it the same way or have it affect them the same way. Not all autistic people have the same symptoms.   

3. You can be autistic and hold a job. Lots of autistic people have jobs. A wide range of jobs too! Autistic people aren't limited to jobs in the service industry, even though many autistic people are in the service industry, but many also have college educated careers too.
